subject: storytime
title: Diary of a Pug words
about: Bub the pug writes a diary about life with his best friend Bella, her big project, and the squirrel and cat who keep getting in his way. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read a few diary pages together each day.

book.author: Kyla May
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A pug's own diary, full of snacks, naps and one big adventure that ends with a blast-off.

passage.text:
pug diary blast off
rocket bath snacks treats
nap sniff wag fetch
cuddle girl because today

cards.note: three parts: di-ar-y; the i says its name and y at the end says ee: dye-ar-ee
b-l blend; s-t at the end
ff is two letters, one sound
two parts: rock + et; ck is one sound
s-n blend; ck is one sound; the s says s
t-r blend; ea says long e; the s says s
s-n blend; ff is one f
all regular; dogs wag their tails
tch is one sound, like ch
dd is one d; le says ul: cud-ul
ir says er, like in her
e says ee, au says u, se says z: be-cuz
o says u; ay says long a: tuh-day
